text:
kait: Pushed a new compact roles + invite mock to Figma: https://figma.com/file/COMPACT_ROLES_2026

kait: Two quick concerns: SSO toggle wording and audit log filters getting cleared when navigating away. Also want to reduce clicks to preview effective permissions.

mike: Compact grid looks good for dense screens. For discoverability, add a subtle chevron on the role row that expands a 1-line permission summary. That gives a tactile target instead of many tiny chips.

anya: Agree on chevron. For keyboard users the chevron should be a single tabbable control per row with aria-expanded. Announce the summary with aria-live when it opens. Example: `button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="perm-123"` then update to true.

priya: Accessibility nit: SSO toggle currently shows color-only state. Change label from "Enforce SSO" to "Require SSO for org sign-in" and add helper copy: "Existing sessions stay signed in; new sign-ins will require your IdP." Put that helper in `aria-describedby` so screen readers read the effect.

jules: Invite CTA microcopy: current "Send invite" is ambiguous when multiple roles selected. Suggest dynamic copy: "Invite 3 people and assign roles" or fallback to "Invite users" when count unknown. Less surprising for admins.

mike: On the invite drawer focus behavior, QA found a trap: open drawer -> open role details -> tab cycles out to page header. We should trap focus to the active overlay and ensure Esc closes nested panels in reverse order. I'll file an eng ticket.

qa-bot: QA steps attached: reproducible on Chrome/Win. Ticket QA-8342. Filters cleared repro steps: open Audit log, set actor + last 30d, navigate to Roles, go back to Audit -> filters reset.

anya: For hover-only affordances, we need a keyboard and touch fallback. Chevron expands on click/tap; on hover show same content. Do not rely on hover for essential info.

priya: Also add a short SR announcement when focus lands on a role row: "Role: Billing Manager. Effective permissions: view invoices, issue refunds." Use polite aria-live so it's not too noisy.

kait: Action items from this thread:
- update SSO label + helper copy + add aria-describedby (priya)
- single expandable chevron per role row with accessible aria attributes (mike + anya)
- dynamic invite CTA that reflects selected count/roles (jules)
- trap focus in invite drawer and ensure nested modals close with Esc (eng ticket, QA-8342)
- persist audit log filters in URL params so state survives nav/back (eng)
- mobile/touch: use tap-to-expand instead of hover (anya)

kait: Can design upload a single compact-screen variant implementing the chevron + outlined role affordance + new SSO copy by EOD? Eng needs to estimate the focus-trap + URL state work.

design-bot: Created ticket PROD-5410: "Compact roles: chevron preview, SSO helper, invite CTA copy" and assigned to design + eng-ux.

mike: I'll take PROD-5410 and scope the accessibility implementation with eng.

jules: I'll prototype the dynamic CTA in the component lib and post the snippet.

priya: I'll draft the aria strings and a short checklist for the review (focus rings, color contrast, aria-live usage).

kait: Thanks everyone. Will update the figma link after changes. Closing the thread for now — follow-ups in PROD-5410 and QA-8342. :white_check_mark:
